title: Feasts of Israel
subtitle: The appointed times of Leviticus 23, and two later feasts
sources: Dates and instructions from the text (Lev 23; Num 28–29; Deut 16; Esth 9; John 10:22). Modern-calendar seasons are approximate, since the Hebrew calendar is lunar. The New Testament column lists passages that connect each feast to Christ or the church; the link for Trumpets is an interpretation, not a stated fulfillment.

feasts.name: Passover
feasts.meaning: The LORD passed over Israel's firstborn under the lamb's blood and brought them out of Egypt.
feasts.ntText: Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed (BSB).

feasts.name: Unleavened Bread
feasts.meaning: Seven days without leaven, remembering the haste of the exodus.
feasts.ntText: Keep the feast with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

feasts.name: Firstfruits
feasts.date: The day after the Sabbath of Unleavened Bread
feasts.meaning: The first sheaf of the barley harvest waved before the LORD.
feasts.ntText: Christ has been raised, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

feasts.name: Weeks (Pentecost)
feasts.ntText: The Holy Spirit poured out on the day of Pentecost.

feasts.name: Trumpets
feasts.meaning: A day of rest proclaimed with trumpet blasts, opening the seventh month.
feasts.ntText: Some connect it with the trumpet at Christ's return; the text does not say so directly.

feasts.name: Day of Atonement
feasts.meaning: The high priest entered the Most Holy Place to make atonement for the people's sins.
feasts.ntText: He entered the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood (BSB).

feasts.name: Booths (Tabernacles)
feasts.meaning: Living in shelters to remember the wilderness; the harvest ingathering.
feasts.ntText: On the last and greatest day of the feast: "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink" (BSB).

feasts.name: Purim
feasts.meaning: The Jews' deliverance from Haman in Persia.

feasts.name: Dedication (Hanukkah)
feasts.meaning: The temple's rededication after the Maccabean revolt (164 BC); Jesus was in the temple at this feast.
